verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents its own automation-style features: Filters & Rules, plus timed actions like Scheduled Send and Snooze that carry out a one-off action later without the user present. However, the pack gives only article titles for Filters & Rules, with nothing showing what they automate or that they run autonomously on the server. Scheduled Send and Snooze are one-off timed actions, not recurring or agentic automations. missing for 10: documented detail that rules run autonomously server-side, recurring or scheduled automation workflows, AI or agentic automation capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Snooze messages to just when you need them.
